about.intro: Aaroh is a house for music and the moving image. We write the song, then find its light.
about.story:
Aaroh is the ascending scale: Sa, Re, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni. Each note a step towards the next. We work the same way, patiently and note by note, until a song and its film arrive as one.

Here, sound and picture are made together, shaped by the same hands and held to the same quiet standard. From the first hum to the final frame.

We are at the beginning. If something here speaks to you, write to us.
